content: Aminoonenne Ti7imaaro
Dawite naa Abeseloomes Ti7imaaro geetettiza mala lo7o michcha dawus; Dawite naa Aminooney izo dosides.
Aminooney ba michcho Ti7imaaro dosida gaason sakettanaashe gakkanaas ceecides; iza geela7o gidida gishshas izi izira aqana dandaybeenna.
Aminoones Iyoonadaabe geetettiza laggey dees; izi Dawite isha Shame7e naa; Iyoonadaabey keehi gene asa.
Izi Aminoone, «Ne gilqa gilqa aqiza gaasoykka aazakkon taas ays yootikkii!» gi oychchides. Aminooney, «Ta isha Abeseloome michcho Ti7imaaro dosida gishshas gilqadis» gides.

Iyoonadaabeykka izas, «Histtiko neni, ‹Tani sakettadis› gaada hiixan keza ichcha; ne aaway nena oychchana yishin, ‹Ta michcho Ti7imaara yaada taas miza miish giigsa immidaakko tana lo7ees; kaththaaka hayssan ta xeellishin giigsada ba kushera iza tana barsana mala azazarkkii!› gaada iza oychcha» gides.

Histtiin Aminooney sakettida as misatidi ichchides; kawozi iza oychchana yiin Aminooney iza, «Ta michcho Ti7imaara yaada ta be7ishin sollo uukkada ba kushera tana barsana mala ta nena woossays» gi oychchides.
Dawiti, «Ne isha Aminooneso baada izas maana kath giigsa» giidi Ti7imaaris yootana mala kawo keeth kiittides.
Hessa gishshas Ti7imaara izi isha Aminooney ichchi dizaso badus; guuththa bukeeso ekkada munuqidaappe guye izi be7ishin giigsada uukkadus.
Hessafe guye basheza kessada solloza izas shiishshadus; gido attiin izi maana koyibeenna. Aminooney, «Ubba asaa hayssafe kessite» gides; diza asay ubbayka iza yeggi kezides.
Hessafe guye Aminooney Ti7imaaro, «Tana barsana mala kaththaa haa ta ichchida kifile ekka ya» gides; Ti7imaara ba giigsida qumaa ekkada ba isha Aminooney ichchida kifile geladus.
Gido attiin iza qumaa izas shiishshiin izi izo curpu histti oykkidi, «Ta michcheyee! Ane issife zin7oos» gides.
Izakka zaarada izas, «Ta ishazoo ta nena shoobbis, agga; hessi hanenna; tana wolqqara oykkofa; hayssa mala miishshi Isra7eelen oosetti erenna; hayssa yeellachchiza ooso ooththofa.

Ta hayssafe guye waananee? Ta kawushshateththaa tookkada ta awa gelanee? Nenikka Isra7eelen kawushsha asatappe issaa mala qoodettana gidikkii? Dicca zay kawozas yoota; izi ta nena gelontta mala diggenna» gadus.
Izi gidikko iza gizayssa siyana koyibeenna; izi izippe keehi mino gidida gishshas izo wolqqara oykkidi izi geela7oteththaa ekkides.
Hessafe guye Aminooney izo keehi ixxides; ubbaaka kase izo siiqoorippe bollara ixxides. Aminooney, «Kichcha ta achchafe keza!» gides.
Izakka, «Hessi hanenna! Neni tana kessa yedoy kase ne ta bolla gaththida qohozappe aaththada tana qohaasa!» gadus; izi gidikko iza gizayssa ekkibeenna.
Izi ba aylleza xeygidi, «Hanno maccassayo kessada karaa gorda» gides.
Hessa gishshas iza gelontta mala kareza gordides; he wode geela7o gidida kawo nayti may7iza alleqo may7o may7a uttadus.
Ti7imaara ba hu7en bidinth laalladus; alleqo may7ozakka daakkadus; hessafe guye ba hu7e baqqa oykkada yeekkashe badus.
Izi isha Abeseloomey izo, «Hessi ne isha Aminooney nenara takkidee? Ta michcheye ane ha7i co7u ga; izi ne isha gidida gishshas ne ceecoppa» gides. Ti7imaara ba isha Abeseloomeson sayo gida uttadus.
Kawo Dawiti he hanoza siyidi keehi hanqettides;
Abeseloomey Aminoone bolla iita gidiin lo7o gidiin issi qaalakka phoqqibeenna; gaasoykka Aminooney iza michcho Ti7imaaro kawushshida gishshas keehi ixxides.
Aminoone Hayqo
Nam7u layththafe guye Abeseloomey Efreeme dhassa matan diza Ba7aali-Haxoore kataman ba dorsata iske qanxxishe heen kawo attuma nayti beettana mala xeygides.
Abeseloomey kawozaakko biidi, «Hekko ne aylley ba dorsata iske qanxxishe dees; hessa gishshas kawozinne iza shuumeti isttas lo7o shene gidikko taas heen beettetto» gi shoobbides.
Kawozikka, «Ta naazoo! Nu ubbay baanaas bessenna; nu nees tooho gidana» gides. Abeseloomey minththi woossiinkka kawozi baana koyibeenna; gido attiin iza anjjidi moyzi yeddides.
Abeseloomey, «Histtiko ta isha Aminooney nunara baana mala azaza» gides. Kawozi, «Izi inttenara ays baanee?» gi oychchides.
Gido attiin Abeseloomey iza minththi woossida gishshas Dawiti Aminooneynne hankko attuma nayti ubbay izara issife baana mala ooththides.

Abeseloomey ba aylletas, «Aminooney woyne ushshaa uyidi maththottanaashe gakkanaas naagettite; hessafe guye tani inttena, ‹Aminoone shocite› giza wode intte iza wodhite; inttena azaziday tana gidida gishshas babbofte, minnite, xalite» gi azazides.
Abeseloome aylleti istta goday istta azazidayssa Aminoone bolla polida; hessafe guye kawoza nayti ubbay ba baqulo baqulo toggidi baqatida.
Istti buro oge bolla dishin, «Abeseloomey kawoza nayta ubbaa wodhi wursides; issaadeyka attibeenna» giza worey Dawitekko gakkides.
Kawozi dendi eqqidi ba may7o daakkides; biitta bolla gufannides; iza matan eqqi diza iza aylleti ubbay bantta may7o daakkida.

Gido attiin Dawite isha Shame7e naa Iyoonadaabey, «Kawo nayta ubbaa wodhi wursidaa misatissidi ta goday qoppofo; iza michcho Ti7imaaro wolqqanththi oykkida wodeppe doommidi Abeseloomey gixxi dendida yo7o gidida gishshas Aminooney xalla hayqqides.
Hayqqiday Aminoone xalla gidida gishshas, ‹Kawo nayti ubbay hayqqida› geetettidayssa kawoy ta goday ammananaas bessenna» gides.

Abeseloomey eeson baqatides. Zabe naagizayssi dhoqqu gi xeellishin izappe arshey wulliza baggara diza ogera daro asati zumaa millera duge wodhdhishin be7ides. Zabe naagizayssi biidi kawozas, «Horonaye baggara zumbullata tiixara asay duge bishin ta be7ays» gi yootides.
Iyoonadaabey Dawites, «Be7a kawo nayti yida; kase ne aylley gidayssa mala hanides» gides.
Izi buro yooti wursontta dishin kawoza nayti waassishenne yeekkishe gelida; hessaththoka kawozinne iza oosanchchati ubbay keehippe yeekkida.
Abeseloomey gangidi Geeshure kawo Amihuude naa Talimayekko bides; gido attiin Dawiti hayqqida naaza gishshas ubba wode yeekkishe gam7ides.
Abeseloomey gangidi Geeshure biidi heen 3 layth uttides.
Kawo Dawiti ba naa Aminoone hayqon gakkida kayoteththaafe minettidaappe guye Abeseloomekko baana iza wozinay dendides.
